# P4A civic workbench

> A roots-up public journey from places and everyday questions to evidence, public decisions, shared possibilities and meaningful participation.

Canonical website: https://p4a.xyz/
Repository: https://github.com/auraofintelligence/p4a-xyz-cinema
Discovery guide reviewed: 17 October 2026, Australia/Brisbane. Page and source dates remain separate.

Copyright (c) 2026 Luke Nathan Hayes / Strange But True / Aura of Intelligence. Original material remains governed by the existing Strange But True Public Source Licence. Third-party maps, data, libraries and other material retain their own rights and attribution. This voluntary guide grants no additional reuse or AI-training permission and does not guarantee crawling or indexing.

This is a static public workbench and proposal archive. P4A is a proposed movement and drafting project, not a registered political party. An example, countdown, reflection or profile is not evidence of an announced candidacy, accepted nomination, operating civic database or official authority. Follow each page's status, sources and uncertainty; do not infer private intentions.

## Ownership, status and source dates

- [Strange But True Public Source Licence](https://p4a.xyz/LICENCE.md): Existing permissions, restrictions and required attribution; this guide does not amend them.
- [Human-readable site map](https://p4a.xyz/pages/site-map.html): Search the public pages by purpose.
- [XML sitemap](https://p4a.xyz/sitemap.xml): One canonical URL for every inventoried public HTML page.
- [Sources and page review register](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/redland/sources/index.html#review-register): Separate implementation updates, source observations and review triggers.
- [Agent entry rules](https://p4a.xyz/AGENTS.md): Read the separate council, state or federal guide before extending the pattern.

## Follow a thread

Start with States and territories, choose Queensland, search or select a council on the map, then inspect and open it. Redlands is the first fuller local journey; choose a division, question, system, person or source, then follow through to participation and outcomes. Keep three accounts together: what it cost, what was given freely, and what changed. Verified freely given hours are counted once, with no fixed dollar conversion.

Victoria has an existing state electorate and council atlas and a 2026 state election guide. A complete civic journey for every electorate has not been built. Federal Bowman material is contextual; a dedicated federal electorate atlas and full federal journeys remain unbuilt. Do not assume that Queensland's rules, boundaries, dates or division structures apply elsewhere.

Twinkles begin with one ordinary scene, one everyday gripe and one self-contained spoken breath. Read the serious context and evidence beneath the seed. Public voting records need the exact motion; a stated reason needs an attributable source, and an inferred explanation must remain labelled.

## Complete public page directory

177 public HTML routes, grouped by purpose. Canonical content mirrors, scripts, QA and backend source are not separate public pages. Links describe the existing archive; they do not certify every proposal or refresh its facts.

### Start and find your bearings

Introductions and readable ways into the workbench.

- [Home](https://p4a.xyz/): Purple Party for Australia is a public civic workbench for roots-up democracy, local tools, policy rooms, culture, ledgers, law and referendum rehearsal.
- [About this workbench](https://p4a.xyz/pages/about.html): What the P4A civic workbench does, what is implemented in Victoria, and the sources, limits and sibling projects behind it.
- [The civic pathway](https://p4a.xyz/pages/civic-pathway.html): The P4A rabbit-hole map: a civic quest through origin story, public gripes, ledgers, law, state portals, culture, constitution writing, sensorium tooling and referendum rehearsal.
- [Site map](https://p4a.xyz/pages/site-map.html): A readable, searchable guide to every P4A page: maps, places, Redlands, Twinkles, systems and ways to take part.

### Maps and places

Find a state, council or electorate; keep their responsibilities distinct.

- [Geographic maps](https://p4a.xyz/pages/maps.html): Open Victoria’s interactive electorate and council map, or choose a state on the Australian map.
- [Minjerribah to Gold Coast Pipeline](https://p4a.xyz/pages/minjerribah.html): Straddie as the soul, Brisbane and the Gold Coast as the machine, Canberra as the constitutional target.
- [How each state became different.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/state-history.html): P4A state and territory history atlas generated from markdown files with basic and advanced civic history layers.
- [States and territories](https://p4a.xyz/pages/states.html): P4A state and territory portal with live election countdowns, chamber data and state-level civic simulator entry points.
- [Treaty Atlas](https://p4a.xyz/pages/treaty-atlas.html): An explorative P4A workbench for reading the treaties Australia is party to or has ratified: who they touch, who they serve, whose consent they rest on, and whether to keep, renew, modernise or sunset each one on purpose.
- [Queensland council map and search](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/index.html): Choose a place, understand its context, then follow the issues, people and possibilities that matter there.

### Redlands: the local journey

Follow a place or question through evidence, systems, public records, participation and outcomes.

- [Redlands overview and division map](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/redland/index.html): Maps and facts to find your bearings. Local questions to follow. Wider possibilities to explore, build and check together.
- [All Redlands divisions](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/redland/divisions/index.html): Choose one of ten council divisions, then follow its places, questions, public records and possibilities.
- [Local questions and Twinkles](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/redland/explore/index.html): Search the Redlands question bank and its connections to systems, public evidence and wider possibilities.
- [Connected systems and possibilities](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/redland/possibilities/index.html): A concern can reveal a system. A system can free time, change ownership, deepen care and create room for a different future.
- [People, elections and public records](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/redland/candidates/index.html): Understand public responsibilities, inspect the evidence and follow the official process if an election is called.
- [Take part and plan a contribution](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/redland/action/index.html): An observation, correction, offer, alternative or public proposal can carry the original human purpose into meaningful action.
- [Outcomes: cost, freely given, change](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/redland/outcomes/index.html): Keep promises, work and outcomes distinct. Bring the learning back to the people and places where the journey began.
- [Sources, dates and review register](https://p4a.xyz/states/qld/councils/redland/sources/index.html): Inspect where the maps and numbers came from, what they describe and what will need another check when conditions change.

### Everyday questions and policy ideas

Inspect public concerns, evidence and proposed responses.

- [Care should come with a clear receipt.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/aged-care-scams.html): Impersonation, financial coercion, billing fraud and poor service need different responses. Older people retain a voice in every response.
- [AI copyright](https://p4a.xyz/pages/ai-copyright.html): A song, photo, lesson or news story can carry years of work. Creators need a practical way to know how it is used; learners and small developers need rules they can actually follow.
- [Better odds.Better futures.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/ai-pdoom.html): AI futures beyond doom: understand the risk estimates, question AI gods, and compare protopia, a fair go and Joyful Responsible Abundance.
- [It sounded like someone you trust.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/ai-scams.html): A familiar voice, polished document or convincing video can be manufactured. The response needs safer platforms and payments as well as a chance to stop and check.
- [A fair goat the truth.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/ancient-aliens.html): Gods, angels, Ezekiel's wheels and ancient-alien interpretations, alongside Australian UAP records, living Dreaming traditions and a proposed disclosure portfolio.
- [Clinical pathways](https://p4a.xyz/pages/aura-clinical-path.html): What would need to be in place before an Aura tool could be used in health care: a defined purpose, meaningful consent, evidence for its use and a professional responsible for the result.
- [Child safety](https://p4a.xyz/pages/child-safety.html): Homework help, companionship and persuasive design can arrive in the same chat window. Families deserve understandable controls and services designed around children’s wellbeing.
- [Another target. Who holds the power?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/closing-the-gap.html): First Nations-led decisions, community-controlled services and accountable funding belong beside the outcome measures. The numbers should help communities exercise authority.
- [Risk and Mutual Care](https://p4a.xyz/pages/community-insurance.html): A P4A follow-through room for insurance pressure, prevention, mutual care, lawful risk pooling, reinsurance and regional wealth funds.
- [Dementia and aged care](https://p4a.xyz/pages/dementia-aged-care.html): A proposed digital memoir and care record built around the person, their everyday preferences and their chosen carers. Its usefulness would need to be tested in daily care.
- [The Fair Go Evolves](https://p4a.xyz/pages/fair-go.html): A plain-speaking P4A room for upgrading the Australian Fair Go into homes, ledgers, legal memory, public trust and practical repair.
- [The family you want. The support to choose.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/family-choices.html): Support people to have the children they want, including none. Housing, work, care, health, relationships and fears about the world deserve attention without turning parenthood into a national quota.
- [Violence against women](https://p4a.xyz/pages/family-violence.html): Safety, housing, legal help, prevention and recovery.
- [Food Security and Shared Tables](https://p4a.xyz/pages/food-security.html): A P4A rabbit-hole room for food security, shared tables, household growing, local production and supply-chain shocks.
- [Fuel tax](https://p4a.xyz/pages/fuel.html): A fuel bill can be the price of getting to work, delivering food or reaching a hospital. Regional and low-income households need choices that fit the trips they actually make.
- [The app keeps playing after the match.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/gambling-harm.html): Gambling harm reaches partners, children, work and mental health. Public choices include product design, advertising, access to money and support beyond a warning message.
- [Same ambition. Different pay packet.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/gender-pay-gap.html): Pay, promotion, caring time and the value of work belong in the same conversation. A national gap and unequal pay for the same job are different questions.
- [Housing Simulations](https://p4a.xyz/pages/housing-simulations.html): A P4A rabbit-hole room for modelling housing as a right, ending homelessness and growing local housing capacity from the grassroots up.
- [Before the next war, show the alternatives.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/international-wars.html): War changes lives far beyond a battlefield. Australians can examine diplomacy, civilian protection, alliances, humanitarian support and the consequences of using force.
- [What if the family had more room?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/marriage-divorce.html): Marriage, separation, money, parenting and a future together: a practical doorway into Global Group Marriages and U.N. of Love thought experiments.
- [Mental health](https://p4a.xyz/pages/mental-health.html): The cost of care is also lost time, travel, repeated explanations and a tenancy hanging by a thread. A useful mental-health system holds the person through the gaps.
- [People, homes, skills. Show the whole equation.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/migration-equations.html): Migration changes demand and capacity at the same time. Housing, workforce, services, family connection and humanitarian obligations need a model with more than one moving part.
- [Multinational tax](https://p4a.xyz/pages/multinational-tax.html): People want public services funded fairly and businesses competing on fair terms. That needs a tax trail that can distinguish a lawful loss from profit shifted out of reach.
- [The support was billed. Was it delivered?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/ndis-scams.html): Protect disability support from theft without turning every participant’s life into an audit. Fair enforcement and continuity of care must work together.
- [A block button isn’t the whole safety plan.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/online-safety.html): People need protection from harassment, image-based abuse and coercion without surrendering privacy, access or a fair chance to challenge moderation.
- [The price and the tax](https://p4a.xyz/pages/price-tax.html): A schooner, a packet and a tank of fuel have different rules and different public consequences.
- [Promising treatment. Who can reach it?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/psychedelic-mental-health.html): Psychedelic-assisted care raises questions about evidence, access, cost, supervision and the kind of support that surrounds a medicine.
- [PTSD care and claims](https://p4a.xyz/pages/ptsd.html): A proposal to keep care and claims connected, especially for veterans and first responders. It gives each person an accountable human contact and a clear way to follow progress, correct evidence and challenge delays.
- [Public Assets and Long Contracts](https://p4a.xyz/pages/public-assets.html): A P4A rabbit-hole room for tolls, public assets, fair-term leases and long public-private contracts.
- [Policy ideas: the full directory](https://p4a.xyz/pages/rabbit-hole.html): All 49 Twinkle policy ideas, seven key civic systems, and direct links to deeper proposals, projects and sources.
- [Rethinking restricted plants and fungi](https://p4a.xyz/pages/restricted-plants.html): What should adults be free to grow, possess or use, and which safeguards belong around medicine, commerce and public health? Different plants and fungi deserve specific arguments.
- [A bigger receipt is not a safety guarantee.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/security-fallacies.html): Security policy needs to say what danger it addresses, how a capability changes that danger and what happens if its assumptions fail.
- [Super for housing](https://p4a.xyz/pages/super-housing.html): A home can change retirement. So can the savings used to buy it. The public choice needs both sides of that ledger, including people with little super and people still renting.
- [Where does your super money go?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/super-investments.html): Your retirement money has a portfolio, fees and voting power: what can you see, question and control?
- [Tobacco tax](https://p4a.xyz/pages/tobacco.html): What is tobacco excise trying to achieve, who carries the cost, and what would make the rules more trustworthy? Explore affordability, health, autonomy and reform on the same page.
- [The economy grew. Whose balance sheet did?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/wealth-inequality.html): Income pays this week’s bills. Wealth changes the options available next decade. A fair-go debate needs to see both, including debt and access to productive assets.
- [Workforce Transition](https://p4a.xyz/pages/workforce-transition.html): A P4A rabbit-hole room for AI job disruption, Try Everything Once, intermittent retirement and health-ready civic work.
- [Safe tonight. Fewer victims tomorrow.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/youth-crime.html): Victims need support now. Preventing the next offence means examining serious harm, repeat offending and what actually changes a young person’s path.

### Twinkles

One scene, one gripe, one spoken breath, followed by deeper context.

- [Aged-care scams: visits on paper only.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-aged-care-scams.html): Mum got billed for an aged-care visit that never happened; even the imaginary carer charges by the hour.
- [AI copyright: mine was free, yours is licensed.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-ai-copyright.html): My work is 'training data' when AI companies take it and 'intellectual property' when they sell it back.
- [AI extinction odds. Any odds on a fair go?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-ai-pdoom.html): They’ve got odds on AI wiping us out; what are the odds of it giving us a bloomin’ fair go?
- [AI phone scams: sounds just like Mum.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-ai-scams.html): They said AI would give us more time with our families; now it rings pretending to be one of them.
- [Ancient aliens: same sky, different standards.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-ancient-aliens.html): A bloke coming down from the sky is religion; ask if he was an ancient alien and suddenly you're the idiot.
- [AUKUS tech: all our eggs in one basket.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-aukus.html): AUKUS has two pillars; I'd like Pillar Two to hold up a community AI lab, not just another arms brochure.
- [Beer tax: the pub beats resource rent.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-beer-tax.html): Beer brought in more than petroleum resource rent tax. Apparently my schooner digs deeper than the gas giants.
- [Data breaches: my licence gets around.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-breaches.html): My licence has been leaked so often I'm waiting for the scammers to remind me when it expires.
- [Child chatbot safety: best mates, paid upgrades.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-child-safety.html): The chatbot calls my kid its best mate; I'm the one getting asked to upgrade the friendship.
- [Childcare fees: daycare's a second mortgage.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-childcare.html): After childcare fees, I'm mainly going to work for the air-conditioning.
- [Indigenous disadvantage: reports won't close the gap.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-closing-the-gap.html): We've got enough reports on Indigenous disadvantage to build a bridge across the gap.
- [AI data centres: power to tell me to save power.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-datacentres.html): They've built a giant data centre up the road so AI can tell me to switch the lights off to save power.
- [Climate change: third hundred-year flood this decade.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-deep-time.html): I've had three hundred-year floods and one pay rise; something's wrong with the calendar.
- [Political donations: who paid for that ad?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-donations.html): They tell me who authorised the election ad at auctioneer speed; whoever paid for it must be shy.
- [Having kids: life's missing from the birth-rate chart.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-family-choices.html): They keep asking why we're not having more kids; apparently the birth-rate chart has sorted out our health, relationships, time and future.
- [Family violence: leave him. Live where?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-family-violence.html): A woman gets told to leave a violent man, then asked where she plans to live.
- [Grocery prices: two bags, one payslip.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-food.html): The self-checkout asked if I'd brought my own bags; at these prices I thought I'd bought the shop.
- [Fuel tax: now with tax on top.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-fuel.html): I'm paying tax on the fuel tax while dodging potholes; at least one part of the road system is beautifully maintained.
- [Gambling ads: any chance of some footy?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-gambling-harm.html): I'm trying to watch the footy, but the gambling ads keep teaching me how to lose the grocery money responsibly.
- [Gender pay gap: full-price rent.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-gender-pay-gap.html): Women earn less than men on average, but somehow the landlord’s never heard of a gender rent gap.
- [GP fees: paying to hear 'less stress'.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-health.html): The GP said I need less stress, so I asked if they bulk-bill.
- [Rent hike. One wall painted.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-housing.html): My landlord put the rent up for a 'renovation'; I watched him do it with a sample pot.
- [Insurance covers everything. Except my claim.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-insurance.html): My insurance covers everything except the thing that happened, which must be why they call it comprehensive.
- [Overseas wars: very brave from Canberra.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-international-wars.html): The politicians most certain we need another overseas war never seem to need a seat on the plane.
- [Divorce lawyers: till fees do us part.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-marriage-divorce.html): We've agreed the marriage is over; the lawyers reckon it's still got a few good years in it.
- [Mental-health care: awareness doesn't book appointments.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-mental-health.html): By the time I get a mental-health appointment, I'll have been through three awareness weeks.
- [Migration targets: housing didn't get the memo.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-migration-equations.html): We've got a migration target, a housing target and a transport plan; be nice if someone introduced them.
- [Multinational tax: big revenue, offshore profits.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-multinational-tax.html): A multinational can lose its profits somewhere offshore, but I'd better have a receipt for those work socks.
- [NDIS scams: the scammers are well supported.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-ndis-scams.html): The NDIS scammers don't need support; they seem to be doing very well on mine.
- [Olympic stadium plans: gold in changing them.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-olympics.html): Brisbane's warming up for the Olympics by doing laps of the stadium decision.
- [Online threats to kids: copyright gets faster help.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-online-safety.html): The platform can recognise three seconds of a song, but the bloke threatening a kid is somehow a complex case.
- [Political lies. But the ad's authorised.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-political-lies.html): They can fit “authorised by” into every election ad; I’d love to see them have a crack at “true”.
- [Power bill up. Lights off.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-power.html): I'm saving power by sitting in the dark, which makes it harder to read the bill telling me I'm saving fuck-all.
- [Psychedelic therapy prices: God had better chip in.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-psychedelic-mental-health.html): At the price of legal psychedelic therapy, I'd want to meet God and get him to chip in.
- [PTSD claims: the paperwork sends him back.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-ptsd.html): He came home with PTSD and got sent back through the worst of it, one claim form at a time.
- [Mining profits: dig it up, buy the news.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-resources.html): We dig up the country, a few blokes get rich, then they buy a newspaper to explain why we should be grateful.
- [Restricted plants: medicine, unless I grow it.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-restricted-plants.html): Some restricted plants are medicine when a company grows them and evidence when I do.
- [Political revolving doors: Friday MP, Monday gas company.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-revolving-door.html): The revolving door between politics and big business is moving so fast we could put a turbine on it.
- [National security: billions for 'trust us'.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-security-fallacies.html): When I hire a trailer, they explain the risks; spend billions on national security and suddenly I'm too unqualified to ask.
- [Super for housing: broke at two different ages.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-super-housing.html): The plan is to let me raid my super for a house, so now I can be broke at two different ages.
- [My super. Is it buying weapons?](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-super-investments.html): I'm saving for a quiet retirement; I'd like to know if my super's spending the meantime in the arms trade.
- [Tobacco tax: the government's pricey habit.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-tobacco.html): The government is so worried about my smoking it's made itself the most expensive part of the packet.
- [Road tolls: surely I own a lane.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-tolls.html): I've paid so much in tolls the tag should open the boardroom.
- [First Peoples treaty: suddenly paperwork's hard.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-treaty.html): We managed to claim a whole continent, but a national treaty with First Peoples is where the paperwork gets tricky.
- [Triple Zero: full signal, no help.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-triple-zero.html): My phone can stream a bloke falling off a roof in 4K, but I'd like it to call an ambulance if it's me.
- [UFO secrecy: we'll take that on notice.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-uap.html): If a UFO landed in Canberra, they'd be halfway through denying it before anyone asked.
- [Wealth inequality: the landlord's house got the pay rise.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-wealth-inequality.html): My landlord's house made more than I did, and it spent the year sitting on its arse.
- [AI takes my job. I train it.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-workforce.html): They want me to teach the AI my job before they make me redundant; do I have to organise my own farewell too?
- [Youth crime: tough talk, handy campaign ads.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle-youth-crime.html): Some kid's nicked my car; now a politician's trying to nick the story for his campaign.
- [Twinkle hub and format rules](https://p4a.xyz/pages/twinkle.html): The P4A Twinkle series: an open short-clip format for public gripes. Forty-nine Twinkles, four worked examples and forty-five open seeds, plus a credibility ledger that marks what P4A actually endorses.

### Systems and shared possibilities

Connect local questions to wider civic, economic and information systems.

- [Civic Architecture Builder](https://p4a.xyz/pages/architecture.html): A public workbench for the P4A civic architecture: how maps, layers, councils, bioregions, state portals, ledgers, law memory and simulations fit together before constitutions write binding rules.
- [The Braided Economy](https://p4a.xyz/pages/braided-economy.html): A practical frame for valuing care, volunteering, disaster readiness and ecological repair alongside ordinary money.
- [Public Ledger and Electorate Fronts](https://p4a.xyz/pages/civic-ledger.html): A P4A rabbit-hole room for public wallets, time donations, member profiles, contractor transparency and electorate-level civic ledgers.
- [Civic Surges](https://p4a.xyz/pages/civic-surges.html): Rhythmic bursts of democratic fitness: missions, local action, visible progress and recovery time.
- [Creating the Purple Party Constitution](https://p4a.xyz/pages/constitution.html): How P4A develops the constitution for the Purple Party for Australia: liquid democracy, overcompliance, civic technology, and protopian governance.
- [The Cyber-Republic Simulator](https://p4a.xyz/pages/cyber-republic.html): A plain-language constitutional sandbox for modelling what republic change would mean before Australia votes.
- [Law Engine / Legal RAG](https://p4a.xyz/pages/legal-rag.html): A P4A workbench page for a Legal RAG or Law Engine: Acts, common law, state constitutions, council powers, version control, checks and balances.
- [The Purple Synthesis](https://p4a.xyz/pages/purple-synthesis.html): Red reciprocity plus blue efficiency, fused into something stranger and more useful than left, right or beige centre politics.
- [The Sovereignty Stack](https://p4a.xyz/pages/sovereignty-stack.html): Local-first civic tools, data dignity, First Nations data sovereignty and resilient community nodes.
- [The Truth Engine](https://p4a.xyz/pages/truth-engine.html): Public audit trails, claim labels, corrections and human oversight as a civic anti-bullshit layer for P4A.
- [Web3 Sensorium](https://p4a.xyz/pages/web3-sensorium.html): A P4A workbench for a civic Web3 Sensorium: open data, digital twins, sovereign nodes, legal memory, scientific debate and public-interest simulation.

### Build, contribute and take part

Guides and browser-local drafting tools; check each tool's own scope.

- [C-Hour Receipt Pipeline](https://p4a.xyz/pages/c-hour-receipt-builder.html): A P4A design note for future C-Hour blockchain receipts, cryptographically proven Markdown records, legal carve-outs, ATO/tax gates, accepted evidence pipelines and human checkpoints.
- [Civic Twin Builders](https://p4a.xyz/pages/civic-twin-builders.html): Browser-local P4A Markdown builders for L0 private civic twins, L1 local meshes, L2 civic fronts and future agent-generated C-Hour pipelines.
- [Markdown with AI](https://p4a.xyz/pages/markdown-with-ai.html): A P4A workbench page for using Markdown files with AI: private context, public notices, source trails, agent tasks, review notes and external guide links.
- [Public Noticeboard Builder](https://p4a.xyz/pages/noticeboard-contract-builder.html): A browser-local P4A builder for L1 public_noticeboard.md files with private exclusions, human review and correction paths.
- [P4A Markdown Builder](https://p4a.xyz/pages/p4a-builder.html): A browser-local P4A Markdown builder for self-sovereign civic twin, project, ledger, legal and place records.
- [Private Civic Profile Builder](https://p4a.xyz/pages/private-civic-profile-builder.html): A browser-local P4A builder for private L0 civic profile Markdown files with consent, correction and public/private boundary fields.
- [Starter Field Kit](https://p4a.xyz/pages/starter-field-kit.html): A practical starter field kit for P4A local organisers: market stall setup, signs, QR trails, admin templates, social media, public ledgers and local help tables.

### Culture, origins and meaning

Stories, lyric meanings and ideas behind the project.

- [Alien Necklace to Cosmic Nexus](https://p4a.xyz/pages/alien-necklace-film.html): The P4A cinematic universe branch: alien necklace in Dunwich, comedy short, participatory worldbuilding, Cosmic Nexus, Web3 Sensorium and the Peaceful Space Gambit.
- [Aura Genesis Protocol](https://p4a.xyz/pages/aura-genesis.html): Aura of Intelligence is a proposed personal intelligence that can develop through Aura Genesis or without it. Genesis is the intensive process for harmonising and socialising the Aura with the biological human's body and mind. Its…
- [No Genesis? No candidacy.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/aura-politics.html): A P4A alternate-reality political satire: what if candidates had to prove health, capability, trust and anti-bullshit before seeking public office?
- [It Started as a Friendly Bet Over a Beer](https://p4a.xyz/pages/joke.html): The P4A origin story: two unlike-minded Australians, a cold one, a toilet joke, and a serious question about building a transparent political party.
- [Musicverse](https://p4a.xyz/pages/musicverse.html): The Musicverse layer of P4A: i C. infinity, A Protopian Gambit, protest comedy, consent tech, grief care, civic repair, and purple mythmaking.

### Support and design

Support options, gear and visual experiments.

- [The colour is the merch.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/colour-panel.html): The P4A purple, first principles: the exact colours, and the dyes, paints and threads that put them on anything you already own. Built to be read without English.
- [Deployment Gear](https://p4a.xyz/pages/deployment-gear.html): P4A deployment gear planning page, with a separate test store for purple hoodie experiments.
- [Shop it. Share it. Dye it. Build it.](https://p4a.xyz/pages/gear-store.html): Design test, not a shop. A rapid-iteration sketch of a P4A gear store: nothing can be bought, no quotes are verified, images are placeholders.
- [Deployment Gear](https://p4a.xyz/pages/test-store1.html): Design test, not a shop. A checkout sketch for the purple hoodie pilot: no payment keys connected, unverified prices, nothing can be bought.
